# Pagelive MCP connector

> Pagelive is a hosted, OAuth-based MCP server that lets an AI assistant publish HTML pages
> (proposals, decks, reports, demos) as private, branded, view-tracked links — and read back
> who opened them and any form replies. Remote connector URL: https://app.pagelive.io/api/mcp
> Namespace: io.pagelive/pagelive. A free Pagelive account works.

## Use it when
- The user says "publish this", "make a shareable link", or "put this on a page".
- The user wants to track opens / viewers / dwell time on a page they shared.
- The user wants to update a previously published page without changing its link.
- The user wants to read replies submitted through a page's form.

## Tools
- publish_page: Publish an HTML page and return a live, view-tracked URL. Pass an existing slug to replace a page in place instead of duplicating it.
- update_page: Edit a published page (targeted text edits or full-HTML replace). The link never changes.
- list_pages: List accessible pages with URLs, workspace, and view counts.
- get_page_stats: Opens, unique viewers, dwell time, top countries for a page.
- list_form_submissions: Read reply-form submissions for a page.
- list_domains: List connected custom domains (Pro/Team).
- list_workspaces: List workspaces (personal + teams).
